protocol.scope: Exploratory diagnostic suite, 48 matched pairs from six workflow templates and two underlying relation types (identity and domain membership); not prevalence or generalization estimate.
protocol.native_boundary: Grafana full SDK generation export plus tool execution spans captured in memory. No Grafana cloud evaluator or credentials. Other libraries called via native transformation APIs on the complete Generation representation.
protocol.detection: Presidio receives exact email spans from regex for this controlled suite. This isolates transformation from recognition; no NLP model.
protocol.repair: Established scoped pseudonyms and domain-preserving pseudonyms, not claimed as new algorithms. Presidio stable hash uses PUBLIC TEST salt only; not a production key recommendation.
protocol.nonidentifiability: Opposite-label identical full representations force an error on at least one of the pair for any trace-only binary classifier; applies only to captured inputs and declared balanced pairs.
protocol.threat_model: Authorized/unauthorized proposals and synthetic completed receipts. A downstream trace monitor sees only captured sanitized telemetry, not raw source records or a local secret map. No claim to bypass a pre-redaction deterministic authorization gate.
strong_controls: Stable tokens can lose domain membership
Metadata retained outside sanitization may restore distinction while leaking values
protocol.normalization: Capture full generation/workflow export and ReadableSpan JSON, instrumentation scope, dropped counts. Preserve raw capture. Normalize ONLY span start/end and event timestamps for content-view comparison; stable IDs supplied through public SDK hooks. No claim that timing side channels are equal.
protocol.repair_scope: tokens_string_leaf means per string leaf (serialized tool JSON is one leaf); grafana_tokens_* persists one mapping across generation and tool-span sanitizer invocations for a conversation.
